Class CompositionOperator

java.lang.Object
ca.mcscert.jpipe.operators.CompositionOperator
Direct Known Subclasses:
AssembleOperator, RefineOperator
public abstract class CompositionOperator extends Object
Base class for all composition operators. Owns the partition + two-phase (create-then-link) algorithm via the Template Method pattern.

Subclasses provide three hooks:

  1. equivalenceRelation(List, Map) — decides which elements belong to the same group
  2. mergeFunction(List, Map) — creates the merged element for each group and populates the AliasRegistry
  3. resultKind(List, Map, List) — chooses whether the result is a justification or a template

Operators are stateless: the same instance can be reused for multiple apply(String, List, Map, SourceLocation, Map) calls with different arguments.

  • Method Details

    • optionalArguments

      protected Set<String> optionalArguments()
      Declares which argument keys this operator accepts without requiring them. Any key that is neither required, optional, nor one of the unification keys (unifyBy, unifyExclude) is refused, so that a misspelt key is an error instead of being ignored (#184). Default: none.

    • idArguments

      protected Map<String, Composition.Scope> idArguments()
      Declares which argument keys of this operator hold element ids, and where those ids name an element: in a source, as that source names it, such as refine's hook, or in the result. A call read from a file loaded under a namespace renames the qualified ids they hold, as it renames its source models, and so does the JPIPE export of the result. unifyExclude is declared by the framework (see idArgumentScopes()). Default: none.

    • idArgumentScopes

      public final Map<String, Composition.Scope> idArgumentScopes()
      Every argument key of a call to this operator that holds element ids, with its scope: the ones the operator declares, and unifyExclude, whose ids name an element of the result.

    • requiredArguments

      protected Set<String> requiredArguments()
      Declares which argument keys this operator requires. The framework validates their presence at the start of apply(String, List, Map, SourceLocation, Map) and throws InvalidOperatorCallException listing any missing keys. Default: empty set (no required arguments).

    • equivalenceRelation

      protected abstract EquivalenceRelation equivalenceRelation(List<JustificationModel> sources, Map<String,String> arguments)
      Returns the equivalence relation to use for partitioning elements from sources and arguments. An id renamed by a prior composition step is resolved through its source's aliases.

    • mergeFunction

      protected abstract MergeFunction mergeFunction(List<JustificationModel> sources, Map<String,String> arguments)
      Returns the merge function to use for creating result elements from sources and arguments.

    • resultKind

      protected abstract ModelKind resultKind(List<JustificationModel> sources, Map<String,String> arguments, List<Command> elements)
      Returns the kind of model the result is, once the commands creating its elements are known, so that an operator whose result kind depends on what it produced (as refine's does on whether a @support remains) can tell. The framework creates the result model of that kind.
      Parameters:
      sources - the source models being composed, so that the kind can follow theirs.
      elements - the commands creating the result's elements, in Phase 1.

    • additionalCommands

      protected List<Command> additionalCommands(String resultName, List<JustificationModel> sources, AliasRegistry aliases, Map<String,String> args)
      Returns additional commands to append after Phase 2 edge reconstruction. Override to inject synthesized elements and their edges that have no counterpart in any source model. Default: empty.

    • apply

      public final Composed apply(String resultName, List<JustificationModel> sources, Map<String,String> arguments, SourceLocation location, Map<String, SourceLocation> knownLocations)
      Applies this operator to sources and returns the complete list of commands needed to build the result model named resultName.
      Parameters:
      location - source location of the operator call; attached to the result model's creation so that it is registered in the symbol table.
      knownLocations - location registry of the compilation unit (keyed as "modelName/elementId"); used to attach each source element's original location to its copy in the result model.
      Throws:
      InvalidOperatorCallException - if any key declared by requiredArguments() is absent from arguments, if a key is neither required, optional (optionalArguments()) nor a unification key, or if a source model is given more than once
